card.name: Statistical methods wording in trial results
card.fires_on: Words inside statistical-method and trial-result sentences, such as 'using' before robust estimation, 'based on' a risk margin, 'Kaplan-Meier' estimates, and '95%' before confidence interval. Fires where the text is about how an estimate was derived.
